scope: One or two salient adult descriptors; not the five latent dimensions; not official measured prevalence.
sampling: Weighted family draw for each slot, allowing repeat family; then distinct compatible supported descriptor. No duplicate descriptor and no family-size synonym weighting.
withinFamily: Use explicit descriptor meaning and compatibility; extreme disruptive descriptors get separately labeled lower candidate weights, not demographic inference. Full per-descriptor weights remain owner-implementer calibration, not supplied as measured rates here.
